title: labisia pumila
intro: Labisia pumila, commonly known as Kacip Fatimah, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including menstrual disorders, menopausal symptoms, and reproductive issues, due to its reported health benefits such as regulating the menstrual cycle and alleviating menopausal symptoms. The therapeutic actions of Labisia pumila are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, that exert antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and estrogenic effects. These bioactive compounds have been shown to modulate the endocrine system, reducing oxidative stress and improving overall health.
